field.label: Generate a number when UPC and EAN are empty
field.comment: Generation is off until you enable it. It runs only when every UPC and EAN attribute is included in the save and is still empty. An existing value is kept, including when a later save leaves the field blank. A 13-digit SKU is copied into an empty field before generation.

field.label: GS1 company prefix
field.comment: Digits only, 6 to 10 characters. The prefix plus the sequence is 11 data digits, then one check digit is added (UPC-A, 12 digits).

field.label: Printer host
field.comment: Leave empty to download a ZPL file only. When set, the product button also sends the label to this printer. UPC-A is printed with ^BUN (11 data digits; the printer adds the check digit). A stored EAN-13 that is not a UPC-A is printed with ^BEN.
